JNU Junior Research Fellow Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 01 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position.

content_sections.heading: JNU Junior Research Fellow Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Desirable Qualification: Background in Applied Mathematics/Computational Fluid Dynamics and knowledge of MATLAB, Latex, Python, etc.

rows.qualification_required: 1. M.Sc. in Mathematics or an equivalent degree in Mathematics (Minimum 55% marks or equivalent CGPA and passed).2. GATE/NET/NBHM in Mathematics.

rows.pay_level_pay: Rs. 37000/- per month + HRA (As per project guidelines)

content_sections.heading: JNU Junior Research Fellow Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of shortlisting based on qualifications, followed by an interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email about the interview, which will be conducted in online mode.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JNU Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official notification PDF. Fill in all required details in the application form accurately. Attach scanned copies of supporting educational and category documents. Send a soft copy of the scanned application form with supporting documents via email to [email protected] . Ensure the email subject line is “Project JRF Application Form”. Submit the application before 12-10-2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Application Form Educational certificates and mark sheets (Class X onwards) GATE/NET/NBHM scorecard No-objection certificate (if currently employed elsewhere) Category certificate (if belonging to SC/ST/PH/OBC/EWS)

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment about?
faq.answer: This notification is for the recruitment of one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position under the ANRF, GOI sponsored project at Jawaharlal Nehru University.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Mathematics or an equivalent degree with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent CGPA, along with a valid GATE/NET/NBHM qualification in Mathematics.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by sending a soft copy of the scanned application form along with supporting documents to [email protected] with the subject line “Project JRF Application Form”.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on qualifications, and shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview conducted in online mode.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly fellowship amount?
faq.answer: The selected Junior Research Fellow will receive Rs. 37000/- per month plus HRA as per project guidelines.

faq.question: Q10. When will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview date is not specified, and only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email.
